Comment: Ambit codebook generator - HAE slice. AI proposes candidate drugs; deterministic states resolve/validate codes; eval gates publish; a human approves before a version is frozen.

VerifyManifest.Comment: Check MANIFEST.sha256 for every reference file before trusting the load (E05 reproducibility).

LoadReference.Comment: Land + version each reference release (crosswalk 07/10, HCPCS 07/10, NDC, ICD-10, billing rules, analyst-owned self-admin). One version per release, effective/end dates kept.

ValidateLoad.Comment: Row-count / key / date checks against the prior release. Emits load_ok boolean.

ResearchCandidates.Comment: The ONLY AI step. Bedrock research agent: disease_area -> candidate drugs + rationale + grounding evidence. Proposes, never decides.

ResolveAndValidate.Comment: For each candidate: deterministic drug->NDC->J-code as-of-version, apply billing rules (incl. BR-6), validate every code. Unknown/retired codes rejected with a reason, never dropped.

BuildDraft.Comment: Assemble resolved + rejected rows into the standard codebook schema; attach reference_versions and aggregate claims_frequency. Status = draft.

EvalGate.Comment: Run the eval suite (>=10 scenarios) against the real tools. Emits eval_passed boolean. Release gate.

AwaitReview.Comment: Human approval. Pauses until a named reviewer approves or rejects the draft via the review app (task token callback).

PublishVersion.Comment: Freeze the approved codebook as an immutable version; write the output CSV + reference_versions manifest.

LoadFailed.Cause: Reference load failed validation; version not published.

ResearchFailed.Cause: Bedrock research step failed after retries.

EvalFailed.Cause: Eval suite did not pass; draft not sent for review.
